tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_switch_weapons_:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.

Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_shodo_sai_Descr:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_shodo_sai_Lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_shodo_sai_shard: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

{{Saicard|name=Falcon Rush|linkspl=Echo Slash}}

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The ability effects are applied as follows:
**# Kez's attack instance.
**# {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
**#* Applies the [[instant attack]] upon proc — after Kez's {{M|attack point}}.
**#** The instant attack component procs all {{M|attack modifiers}} with a {{#var:Falcon Rush type1 value4}} proc chance reduction, and other {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal.
**#*** The proc chance reduction does not apply to the following sources:
**#**** {{A|Kez|Kazurai Katana}}
**#**** {{A|Kez|Shodo Sai}}
**#*** Does not have {{M|True Strike}}.
**#*** Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
**#* {{Symbol|Evasion}}
**#** Hence, defensive [[evasion]] procs on the enemy unit do not affect the instant attack component proc.
**#** However, if the enemy target is {{G|melee miss range}} range farther than Kez's {{M|attack range}}, the attack will miss regardless.
**#* The instant attack effect delay is defined as:
**#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|DelayTime {{=}} ({{#var:Falcon Rush value1}} - EnemyDistance) × {{#var:Falcon Rush type1 value2}}}}

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Displays the current {{M|base attack time}} on ability tooltip, and updates upon hover.
** Interrupts Kez's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|kez_falcon_rush}}
*** Reapplying the buff refreshes its duration, changing targets do not dispel the buff.
*** The buff procs on either an attack command, [[File:Dota2 RMB.png|21px|Right-Click]] on a {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy, a {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted ability cast, except the following:
**** {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} Ground-targeted commands.
**** Auto-attacks.
**** On {{M|attack immune}} units.
***** However, they are considered valid targets if the buff is applied to Kez prior to the enemy unit being affected by the attack immune source.
**** An attack command while active on {{M|allied units|x}} causes Kez to rush toward the targeted unit, and searches for another valid enemy unit within the radius centered around the allied unit, then rushes toward the enemy unit.
*** {{M|Disarm}} sources disable the attack component, but do not affect the ability to issue an attack command.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}}
*** Grants the following ability effects upon proc:
**** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
***** Grants a non-lingering 100-radius [[flying vision]] centered around Kez upon proc, until the {{M|instant attack}} application.
**** The {{M|attack range}} reduction.
**** {{M|Haste movement}}.
**** {{M|Phase movement}}.
*** The following actions do not cancel Falcon Rush:
**** {{Symbol|Target|No}} Non-targeted ability casts.
**** {{M|Doubletap}} or self-targeted ability casts.
*** '''Other new issued commands or conditions not listed cancels Falcon Rush while rushing.'''
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|Basic Dispel}}
*** The following offensive sources [[dispels]] the buff:
**** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
**** {{M|Hex}} sources.
**** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
**** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
**** {{M|Stun}} sources.
*** For other disable sources:
**** {{Symbol|Taunt}}
***** [[Taunt]] sources cause Kez to rush toward the taunting unit.
***** Forced attacks of taunt sources do not dispel the buff.
**** {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***** Rushes toward the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy's last known location when the enemy is affected by the following sources:
****** {{M|Fog of War}}.
****** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
****** {{M|Invisible}} sources.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_kez
data.bio_loc: "I was born with a price on my head. As I got better at causing trouble, that price went up. Every time Queen Imperia raised the bounty, I knew I must have done something right. I think that's the worst part about being gone so long in Icewrack... I've got to get that price back up to a respectable number."
data.hype_loc: When it comes to strategy, Kez tends to wing it — he's able to swap on the fly between his katana and sai to slash, dash, swoop, and parry as the needs of the battlefield demand. But when he puts his mind to it, he can account for any eventuality, choosing the right tool to attack, escape or simply outwit his enemies with a little advance planning.
data.npe_desc_loc: Flexible melee master with two sets of weapons and abilities

abilities.name: kez_echo_slash
abilities.desc_loc: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.

abilities.name: kez_grappling_claw
abilities.desc_loc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
abilities.lore_loc: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.

abilities.name: kez_kazurai_katana
abilities.desc_loc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
abilities.lore_loc: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
abilities.shard_loc: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

abilities.name: kez_switch_weapons
abilities.desc_loc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
abilities.lore_loc: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

abilities.name: kez_raptor_dance
abilities.desc_loc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
abilities.lore_loc: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
notes_loc: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

abilities.name: kez_falcon_rush
abilities.desc_loc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
abilities.lore_loc: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.

abilities.name: kez_talon_toss
abilities.desc_loc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
abilities.lore_loc: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
notes_loc: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

abilities.name: kez_shodo_sai
abilities.desc_loc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
abilities.lore_loc: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
abilities.shard_loc: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

abilities.name: kez_ravens_veil
abilities.desc_loc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
abilities.lore_loc: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
